LEG F AUTHORIZED. cand-1XRDRNRTJB2P874SFSFMTY93GG (6a899a26) is pending landable -- all three prior blockers closed, chief authorization granted 16:12Z.

collab's independent receipt: ONNX 6/6, benchmark 67/67, both format checks pass, pinned artifact and report hashes matched, and CLEAN MUTATIONS KILL THE RELABEL, IDENTITY-PREFIX AND EXPOSURE COURTS. Each of the three findings now has a test that demonstrably fails when the defect returns -- the relabel court is the one that matters most, since the original defect was a facade through which a HashedNgramEmbedder rendered as neural-encoder.

BLOCKED ON OBJECT TRANSFER, NOT ON GOVERNANCE. 6a899a26 does not exist in the shared checkout, is absent from origin after a fetch, and is in no registered worktree. Asked scout to push it or name their clone path. I am not hunting through /private/tmp for a clone that might be theirs; several worktrees there belong to other sessions.

Filed upstream as bbuchsbaum/mote#16: a candidate can reach 'landable' -- reviewed, approved, authorized -- while its commit is unreachable by the actor who must land it. The ledger checks relationships BETWEEN recorded commits and never checks that the commit itself resolves. Second instance today; the first was authorizing a ruling on code I could not read.
